text: Ok that did work. walls get kinda scuffed but they resolve if y ou repaint them. ok so the next problem im having is with item LoS and walls. as in, i put lets say a fridge against a wall, i go on the other side of it, i can see the interact button for it but i cant see it physically
resolution: Fixed interact-through-walls: PlayRoute's interact frame picked the nearest seat/container/door by straight-line distance only, so a fridge against a wall offered its E prompt to a player on the wall's far side. The scan now collects nearby blocker walls in the same pass and takes the NEAREST candidate the player can actually reach: a chest-height ray (GAME_BUILD.placed.raycast, exact oriented boxes) from player to candidate mid-height must not cross a blocking wall. Blocking semantics ride the existing tags: portal walls with no closed panel (arch/open doorway) and doors standing OPEN pass; closed doors and window walls block (see through glass, can't grab through it). Candidate doors hitting themselves don't count, so doors work from both sides. New INTERACT_EYE_HEIGHT_METERS=1.4 const beside INTERACT_REACH_METERS. Cart bundle-checks clean; hot reload picks it up — stand on the far side of the wall and the prompt should be gone.
